relevance.reason: Questions ROI on AI spending - makes the point that AI investments should deliver value like any other budget item. Relevant for business decision-makers.

title: AI cost management: How we track and optimize AI spend at Zapier
author: Ryan Roccon
content_snippet: Does $5,000 in AI spend equal $5,000 in value? If it does, that's a bad investment. A 1x return wouldn't get approved anywhere else in our budget, and AI doesn't get an exception. As the Chief Operating Officer at Zapier, the question I really care about is whether that investment returned more than it cost.
